name: Good interaction algorithm and Fourier analysis
description: An interaction algorithm with methods for efficient Fourier analysis developed in a study of factorial experiments.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: I. J. Good published an interaction algorithm and related Fourier-analysis shortcuts.

evidence.supports: Good’s original summary describes an interaction algorithm and Fourier shortcuts in July 1958.
The Cooley coauthored history distinguishes Good’s prime-factor and Cooley–Tukey algorithms.

events.caveats: The publisher abstract was inspected, but the original full text was unavailable; the 1967 history characterizes the prime-factor method.
